method: Actual per-triangle3Dmetric versus accepted float32 normalizedUV Jacobian. Atlas width/height packing included. Not a judgment of painted strand correctness.
interpretation: Positive unique UV does not guarantee source-groom direction or low distortion. Harmonic parting/rim flow is a coarse inferred field, not measured source strands. Generated marks can bunch under this variable map and mask transitions; unchanged gray geometry does not show those new streaks, so paint result alone does not establish bad3Dshape.
